title: I found why Qwen3.8-27B was 14× slower on my 4070 Super
body: I downloaded the Q4_K_M GGUF and got 5.7 tok/s. The same file did 81.5 tok/s on a 5090. The 4070 Super run completed normally, but only 38 of 66 layers were on the GPU. The other 28 ran from system RAM on the CPU. I spent an hour assuming the model was just slow.
